summary: The proof correctly converts the prescribed full sections and Q_{jk} area into a lower bound on the right-hand width-slope jump, transfers that bound by concavity to the negative-U cap, and obtains |Q_j| <= 121/850. Unsupported strict chambers and cutting-line boundary cases are adequately excluded, all area and derivative inequalities have the correct direction, and the numerical contradiction with |Q_j| = 1/5 is exact.
